GlobalPolicy.evidence-format: module-id, verification-ref, artifact-path, mode, editor-profile, preservation-ledger, expected, actual, verdict, collection-sync
GlobalPolicy.module-level-focus: Check ConciseStudentTaskCard order, exact hints and metadata, minimal code, absence of legacy or full-document markers, and local references close to the changed artifact.
GlobalPolicy.wave-level-focus: Prove each serialized 8 + 8 + 5 redesign unit and atomic synchronization across cards, thematic, optional interview, and supported real-work collections, knowledge graph, verification plan, local deterministic evidence, pushed commit, complete report, and Beads status.
GlobalPolicy.phase-level-focus: Validate all GRACE XML, the explicit temporary twenty-slug compatibility state, twenty-one-card and fourteen-collection target integrity, editor-profile URLs as content, controlled vocabulary, and source-Markdown structure.
GlobalPolicy.autonomy-gate: Every module requires executable or manual checks, observable artifact evidence, stop conditions, and wave or phase follow-up before autonomous edits.
GlobalPolicy.final-user-review-gate: Per-wave human approval is not required. After the technical final audit, the top-level story remains open until the user reviews and accepts the complete library.
GlobalPolicy.redaction: Never include secrets, credentials, private student data, or proprietary source material in repository content or evidence.

VF-001.NAME: StudentStudiesTask
VF-001.scenario: A student selects a thematic, interview, or real-work collection, opens a suitable task, copies minimal complete code to the named editor, controls hint and solution disclosure, and returns with browser Back.
VF-001.expected-outcome: Root, collection, task, and editor links work; title and duration match; condition and minimal starter are visible; exactly three hints, the concise solution, and metadata are independently collapsed; legacy navigation, readiness, self-check, theory, and harness sections are absent after cutover.

required-signals.artifact-marker: README.md collection link and CollectionEntry relative task link
target-editor instruction, complete starter code, three exact hints, and five-field metadata
required-signals.trace-sequence: HUB_OPENED -> COLLECTION_SELECTED -> TASK_OPENED -> EDITOR_OPENED -> CODE_COPIED -> HINT_1_OPTIONAL -> HINT_2_OPTIONAL -> HINT_3_OPTIONAL -> SOLUTION_OPTIONAL -> BROWSER_BACK

VF-002.NAME: AgentAddsTask
VF-002.scenario: An AI agent adds one task from a mentor request.
VF-002.expected-outcome: An accepted task card, exactly one thematic collection, zero or one interview, supported real-work membership when applicable, graph and verification entries, and local deterministic evidence change atomically; the serialized wave closes after push and complete report pass.

required-signals.artifact-marker: unique thematic CollectionEntry, optional interview entry, and supported real-work entry when applicable

VF-003.NAME: AgentUpdatesTask
VF-003.scenario: An AI agent changes or migrates task content without losing the source learning goal, prerequisite, runtime assumptions, or student navigation.
VF-003.expected-outcome: CardMigrationEvidence is complete with external execution recorded as NOT_RUN; local deterministic evidence passes; thematic, optional interview, and supported real-work data when applicable, graph and verification facts, assets, and links remain consistent; ambiguity stops before drift.

unique thematic, zero-or-one interview, and supported real-work synchronization when applicable

commands.command-3: Record all results, remaining risks, pushed commit, pull request state, and final user-acceptance request in Beads.

required-evidence.evidence-1: PASS: the complete 34-page URL inventory and deep flow matrix passed on the published student experience.
required-evidence.evidence-2: The top-level story remains open until the user explicitly accepts the complete migrated library.
required-evidence.evidence-3: All four external editor surfaces opened, all six editor-profile instructions rendered, and the three former fixture cards passed the deep flow without hidden asset dependencies.

Gate-Phase-16.goal: The concise target contract is staged consistently while the observable current state remains exactly twenty legacy-marker cards and thirteen collection pages.

commands.command-1: test "$(rg -l 'Готово, когда|Самопроверка|← Все подборки|Потерялись\?' tasks/*/README.md | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 20
commands.command-2: test "$(find collections -mindepth 3 -maxdepth 3 -name README.md | sort | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 13
commands.command-3: xmllint --noout docs/requirements.xml docs/technology.xml docs/development-plan.xml docs/verification-plan.xml docs/knowledge-graph.xml docs/operational-packets.xml

artifact-checks.artifact-check-16-1: Template contains only focused and real-work concise variants; governance and validation name the same twenty compatibility slugs and Phase 19 expiry.
artifact-checks.artifact-check-16-2: Requirements, technology, development, verification, graph, and packets all distinguish the implemented twenty-card/thirteen-collection catalog from the planned twenty-one-card/fourteen-collection target.

required-evidence.evidence-1: Baseline output is exactly twenty and thirteen; XML and whitespace gates exit zero; the placeholder scan has no matches.
required-evidence.evidence-2: No task, collection, root hub, or future migration evidence is changed or marked implemented.

Gate-Phase-16.blocked-when: BLOCKED if the baseline count, compatibility inventory, XML, placeholder, diff, cross-reference, or planned-status check fails.

Gate-Phase-17.goal: Exactly eight named Wave A cards become focused concise cards with synchronized local deterministic, graph, verification, collection, and Beads evidence.

commands.command-1: Enumerate the changed task paths and compare them exactly with immutable-category-totals, stable-product-sort, loop-closure-bindings, browser-event-loop-order, discriminated-load-state, typed-object-property, response-union-narrowing, and validate-unknown-profile.
commands.command-2: Run the deterministic per-card structure, three-hint, closed-details, no-legacy, no-full-document, five-field metadata, and unique thematic membership checks from docs/task-validation-policy.md.
commands.command-3: Review each card's condition, starter, solution, expected result, and manual check in source Markdown; record both target-editor result fields as NOT_RUN: Markdown-only delivery and complete CardMigrationEvidence in the owning Beads issue.

artifact-checks.artifact-check-17-1: Eight task paths, eight graph exports, eight verification facts, their thematic and optional interview projections, and eight Beads records agree.
artifact-checks.artifact-check-17-2: No Wave B, Wave C, real-work, root, or collection-inventory cutover fact changes.

required-evidence.evidence-1: Eight final local deterministic verdicts and complete CardMigrationEvidence records are PASS; all sixteen target-editor result values are NOT_RUN: Markdown-only delivery.
required-evidence.evidence-2: The focused wave commit is pushed and its complete local-evidence report is recorded before closure.

Gate-Phase-17.blocked-when: BLOCKED if any central action, structure, metadata, local link, membership, graph, verification, Beads, pushed-commit, or local deterministic evidence is missing, contradictory, or failing.

Gate-Phase-18.goal: Exactly eight named Wave B cards become focused concise cards with minimal markup and local Markdown-only evidence.

commands.command-1: Enumerate the changed task paths and compare them exactly with this-callback-binding, stale-search-response, delegated-dynamic-list, idempotent-event-listeners, accessible-keyboard-tabs, modal-focus-lifecycle, flex-long-text-overflow, and container-responsive-grid.
commands.command-2: Run deterministic concise per-card checks and review accessibility, keyboard, CSS, and manual-check wording for internal consistency in source Markdown; do not open an editor or browser.
commands.command-3: Record complete CardMigrationEvidence and synchronized graph, verification, thematic, optional interview, and Beads facts for all eight cards.

artifact-checks.artifact-check-18-1: Eight task paths and only their necessary catalog, graph, verification, and Beads facts change.
artifact-checks.artifact-check-18-2: JavaScript cards contain no full HTML document; CSS and visual behavior is described by visible requirements and manual-check wording rather than automated style assertions.

required-evidence.evidence-1: Eight complete CardMigrationEvidence records use NOT_RUN: Markdown-only delivery for both target-editor fields and pass local deterministic gates.
required-evidence.evidence-2: The focused wave commit is pushed and its complete local-evidence report is recorded before closure.

Gate-Phase-18.blocked-when: BLOCKED if minimal markup changes the stated behavior, required context is missing from Markdown, CSS or accessibility wording contradicts starter or solution content, a required local link fails, or synchronization drifts.

Gate-Phase-19.goal: Wave C and the catalog cut over atomically to twenty-one concise cards, fourteen collections, five formats, and one supported users-api-list real-work projection before compatibility is removed.
Gate-Phase-19.sequence: Run every command with compatibility still present; only after complete PASS remove the exact compatibility exception, then rerun the same commands unchanged and require a second complete PASS before Phase 19 can complete.

commands.command-1: test "$(find tasks -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name README.md | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 21
commands.command-3: test "$(find tasks -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name README.md -print0 | xargs -0 rg -l 'Готово, когда|Самопроверка|← Все подборки|Потерялись\?|<details open' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 0
commands.command-4: For every sorted task path, run the exact hint, open-details, full-document, five-field controlled metadata, and unique thematic membership commands in docs/task-validation-policy.md.
commands.command-5: test "$(rg -o 'tasks/[a-z0-9-]+/README\.md' collections/real-work/README.md | sort -u)" = 'tasks/users-api-list/README.md' and compare that set with every card whose format is Приближённая к реальной работе.
commands.command-6: Verify README.md has exactly four second-level headings, fourteen collection links, and four approved editor links; run xmllint on the six GRACE XML artifacts and git diff --check.

artifact-checks.artifact-check-19-1: The four React migrations, users-api-list, collections/real-work/README.md, its thematic projection, root link, graph export, verification facts, and Beads records change atomically.
artifact-checks.artifact-check-19-2: The exact twenty-slug compatibility text is removed only after the first complete structural and local deterministic PASS; the identical scan passes again after removal.

required-evidence.evidence-1: All twenty-one cards have exactly three hints, five controlled metadata fields, one thematic membership, and no legacy, open-details, or full-document marker.
required-evidence.evidence-2: users-api-list alone has the real-work format and collection membership; its Markdown locally contains every required React/DummyJSON state, failure branch, expected result, and manual-check instruction.
required-evidence.evidence-3: The focused cutover commit is pushed with complete wave evidence; Phase 20 remains planned.

Gate-Phase-19.blocked-when: BLOCKED if any count, marker, metadata, local link, membership, root, graph, verification, Beads, local DummyJSON contract, or atomicity check fails; compatibility must not be removed while a failure remains.

Gate-Phase-20.goal: The local thirty-six-file student experience is structurally consistent and is handed to the user without inferring final acceptance.

commands.command-1: Enumerate the local root, all fourteen collection files, and all twenty-one task files; record file presence, title, relative links, balanced code fences, and closed details structure.
commands.command-2: Run the source-Markdown structural and synchronization scans for each technology, all interviews, both task classes, all editor profiles as content, the real-work projection, and users-api-list required states.
commands.command-3: Fetch origin, report branch divergence, pushed commit and pull-request state, and reconcile the local inventory with graph, verification, and Beads evidence.

artifact-checks.artifact-check-20-1: One root plus fourteen collections plus twenty-one cards equals thirty-six recorded local Markdown files with no missing path or unresolved relative link.
artifact-checks.artifact-check-20-2: The final report records remaining risk and leaves the top-level story and user-acceptance decision open.

required-evidence.evidence-1: Every local path, title, relative link, details pair, fence, editor instruction, and collection membership has a current deterministic result.
required-evidence.evidence-2: External editors, browsers, live APIs, and GitHub-rendered pages are not opened or operated and their availability has no effect on PASS or BLOCKED.

Gate-Phase-20.blocked-when: BLOCKED if any required local path, relative link, Markdown structure, catalog projection, XML/Beads synchronization fact, branch-divergence result, or evidence record is missing or failing.

packet-template.expected-fields: scenario, contract-ref, mode, editor-profile, preservation-ledger, target-editor-expected, target-editor-actual, target-editor-verdict, collection-sync, expected-evidence, observed-evidence, first-divergent-artifact-or-anchor, next-action
packet-template.stop-conditions: three distinct hints unavailable; code incomplete in Markdown; undescribed file; ambiguous technology, editor instruction, task class, or profile; unnecessary multi-file split; FILE mismatch; full-document JavaScript wrapper; embedded asset replacement mismatch; metadata and collection drift; duplicate thematic or interview membership; unsupported real-work membership; broken required local relative link; failed local deterministic evidence; incomplete technical publication
